leadText: Latios (Japanese: ラティオス Latios) is a character from Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias.
plainText:
Latios (Japanese: ラティオス Latios) is a character from Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias.

==In the movies==
 
Latios and his sister lived in the Secret Garden in Alto Mare, where they were the guardians of the Soul Dew. They were friends with Lorenzo and . Latios and Latias presented some very unique powers in the movie, such as sight-sharing, invisibility, and shapeshifting.

 
At the end of the , Latios had to sacrifice himself to save Alto Mare, and turned into the new Soul Dew. In the ending credits, two Latios can be seen flying with Latias. They are believed to be the spirits of Latios and his father.

In The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon, Latios was seen in Pikachu's memories. He also briefly reappeared in a montage in The Rise of Darkrai, which chronicled the preceding nine movies.

===Personality and characteristics===
 
Latios has shown to have been a very mature and selfless protector, valiantly sacrificing his own life for the sake of both his and the town of Alto Mare. He also had a no-nonsense, very serious personality.

Although he did not like to fight, he would attack intruders of the without hesitation or anyone attempting or succeeding to inflict harm on his sister Latias. As a result of his personality traits, he was extremely protective of Latias.

==Trivia==
Latios is the first of a few Pokémon in the who perished in the present day and were never brought back to life or through time travel.
Latios's original voice wasn't retained in the dub, which opted to use 's Japanese voice actor instead.
In Pokémon Adventures, are shown being capable of using a sight-sharing power similar to that used by Latios and Latias in Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias.
